newsitem.title: Austria: Austrian shares end firm,buoyed by OMV and Boehler.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end firm,buoyed by OMV and Boehler.

text.p: 1410 GMT - Austrian shares end firmer, buoyed by demand for OMV and Boehler shares.
Traders said extended trading hours had little impact on day's turnover.
Underlying market sentiment remains positive. Resistance on ATX seen at around 1,183 to 1,185 points.
* February ATX future up 8.2 points at 1,184.
* 12 ATX shares up, 11 down, one unchanged
* Top gainer OMV, up 2.23 percent at 1,340.
* Leading decliner Wolford, down 3.04 percent at 1,435. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254
